Produces: Infinite blinking; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite colorless mana; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite self-mill; Infinite storm count; Put all land cards from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield; Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0
Start: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods (battlefield); Famished Worldsire (battlefield); Eldrazi Confluence (hand); Vampire Charmseeker (battlefield); Horizon Explorer (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
  Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire.
  As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
  When Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
  Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
  Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
  Repeat.
Notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Vampire Charmseeker and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

## Combo 1011-2034-2728-5662
Cards: Genestealer Patriarch + Ashnod's Altar + Fate Transfer + Reyhan, Last of the Abzan
Color identity: BGU | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{U/B}
Produces: Infinite colorless mana; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Genestealer Patriarch (battlefield); Ashnod's Altar (battlefield); Fate Transfer (hand); Reyhan, Last of the Abzan (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
  An opponent controls a creature.
  You control at least two additional creatures.
Steps: Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
  Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
  Activate Fate Transfer's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
  Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
  When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
  Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
  Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
  Repeat from step 4.
